prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game battle HUD top strip background
Primary request: Create a wide top HUD strip background for a post-apocalyptic armored car survival game, optimized for readability of overlay text and progress bars.
Scene/backdrop: no scene, pure UI asset only
Subject: one horizontal top HUD panel strip with restrained sci-fi industrial styling
Style/medium: premium mobile game UI, polished 2D game sprite, clean production-ready HUD art
Composition/framing: ultra-wide horizontal strip, symmetric silhouette, slightly tapered armored ends, large calm center area reserved for text, subtle edge detailing only
Lighting/mood: low-key, controlled metallic highlights, readable not flashy
Color palette: dark graphite, gunmetal gray, faint amber accent lights, low contrast interior center
Materials/textures: brushed metal, soft bevels, very light wear, minimal grime, no busy scratches in the center
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: keep the center 70 percent visually quiet for text readability; decoration should live mostly on the far left and far right edges; no large glowing ornaments behind the center title area; no embedded text; no icons; no heavy patterning; no strong vertical streaks in the center
Avoid: busy mechanical clutter, bright hotspots under text, strong orange glow bands, complex panel seams crossing the middle, perspective distortion, scene elements, characters, weapons
Background: plain solid dark neutral backdrop only for easy cropping

Use case: stylized-concept

Scene/backdrop: no scene, pure UI asset only
Subject: one isolated horizontal bar frame with simple industrial silhouette and readable inner track
Style/medium: premium mobile game UI, clean 2D HUD sprite, restrained sci-fi industrial styling
Composition/framing: long horizontal bar with modest rounded armored caps, centered recessed inner groove for the fill, symmetrical, compact end shapes
Lighting/mood: subtle metallic highlights, clear edge definition, calm and readable
Color palette: dark steel, graphite, muted bronze accents, low contrast center groove
Materials/textures: light brushed metal, subtle bevel, minimal wear, no heavy ornament, no bolts or protrusions over the inner groove
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: the fill area must read as one clean continuous channel; end caps must stay visually light and not overpower the fill; suitable for sliced scaling; no embedded text; no iconography
Avoid: complex mechanical claws, large glowing end pieces, thick frame lips covering the fill, perspective distortion, background plate, scene elements
